name: io.github.opsloft/tariff-resolver
description: US import tariff research for AI: HTS code candidates, MFN/FTA rates, Chapter 99 additional duties (IEEPA/Section 301/232), MPF/HMF fees, landed cost components and tariff-change tracking. Official USITC public-domain data, 35,000+ tariff lines. Keywords: tariff, HTS, HS code, landed cost, customs duty, de minimis, import tax.
